name: Rotating Equipment — Pumps, Compressors, Blowers, Fans & Drivers

work_packages.note: Higher mass/inertia foundations for reciprocating/large machines; anchor template survey critical
Set pump/compressor and motor; coarse coupling alignment
Suction/discharge spools connected with dial-indicator pipe-strain verification
Laser/dial coupling alignment after piping and at operating condition; hot alignment where thermal growth applies
Lube oil, seal flush/gas, cooling water, seal support systems flushed and functional
Motor power, VFD, vibration/temperature protection, control

activities: Accept inertia block/foundation at spec strength
Anchor template and level survey
Confirm any pockets, drains, curbs
sequence.note: Reciprocating and large centrifugal machines demand mass foundations and tight anchor tolerance

activities: Offload; inspect preservation, seals and shaft for transit damage
Set baseplate/skid on levelling screws over anchors
Mount driven machine and driver where shipped loose
sequence.note: Shaft turned by hand to confirm free rotation before setting

activities: Level baseplate to precision tolerance
Epoxy grout baseplate; cure
Final anchor torque after cure
Rough coupling alignment (before piping) — set for expected pipe/thermal movement
sequence.note: Coupling left disconnected until precision alignment; rough alignment gives a datum

activities: Fabricate and connect suction/discharge/process spools to nozzles
Independently support piping — spring hangers set
Dial-indicator pipe-strain check: watch coupling move as flanges are bolted
sequence.note: If the coupling moves beyond tolerance when a flange is torqued, the spool is re-worked — the machine is never pulled to the pipe

activities: Terminate motor power and any VFD
Land vibration, bearing-temperature, seal and process protection instruments
Earth/bond motor and baseplate
Terminate lube/seal skid controls
sequence.note: Protection and trips wired before any spin

activities: Coupling final (cold) alignment within tolerance
Bearing clearances, lube levels verified
Rotation-direction (bump/uncoupled solo motor run) confirmed
Mechanical completion walkdown
sequence.note: Solo motor bump test confirms rotation with coupling disconnected — reverse rotation can destroy a pump/seal

activities: Lube-oil and seal-system flush to cleanliness spec
Connected-piping hydrotest and flush
Loop-check protection instruments and trips
Solo motor run (uncoupled) — vibration, current, temperature
sequence.note: System flushing to particle-count spec protects bearings and seals

activities: Recouple after solo run; recheck alignment
No-load / minimum-flow run of the train
Set relief/recycle, verify seal flush and cooling
sequence.note: Hot alignment re-check on machines with significant thermal growth

activities: Load run at process conditions
Performance test vs curve; vibration signature baseline
Trip and interlock live test
Handover / acceptance run

typical_relationships.reason: Alignment done on an ungrouted, unbolted baseplate will not hold once the base is finally fixed
Pipe strain moves the machine casing; final alignment must reflect the as-connected state

typical_relationships.before: Lube-oil / seal system flushed to cleanliness spec
typical_relationships.after: Any rotation of the machine under lubrication
typical_relationships.reason: Running on unflushed oil drives contaminant into bearings and seals and wrecks the machine

typical_relationships.after: Coupling the driver to the driven machine
typical_relationships.reason: A reverse-rotating pump or compressor coupled up can be destroyed on first start; direction is proven with the coupling open

typical_relationships.before: Protection and trip instrument loop-checks (vibration, temperature, low-flow)
typical_relationships.reason: The machine must be protected before it turns; trips are the last line against a mechanical failure
The motor and baseplate must be earthed before power is applied
No-load confirms rotation, vibration and seals before the machine is loaded against process

interfaces.requirement: Setting REQUIRES an inertia block/foundation at strength with anchors surveyed to template
Final alignment REQUIRES suction/discharge/process spools connected and independently supported, with a pipe-strain check at the coupling
Solo run and commissioning REQUIRE motor power (and VFD) terminated, tested and available
First run REQUIRES vibration/temperature/low-flow protection instruments looped and trips proven
Auto operation REQUIRES control/monitoring signals mapped and the start/stop/trip logic proven in the control system
Energisation REQUIRES motor and baseplate bonded to the earthing grid
Seal/bearing cooling REQUIRES cooling-water/utility supply available and flushed
Seal-gas / instrument-air / lube auxiliaries REQUIRE their utility headers live and clean

testing_requirements: Baseplate level and epoxy-grout cure records
Cold coupling alignment within OEM tolerance (offset/angularity)
Solo uncoupled motor run — rotation direction, current, vibration, bearing temperature
Protection loop-check and trip test (vibration, bearing temp, low/no flow)
No-load then full-load run with vibration signature and performance-vs-curve verification
commissioning_dependencies: Grout cured, anchors torqued, precision alignment complete in as-connected state
Lube/seal/cooling auxiliary systems flushed and functional
Motor power and VFD available and tested
Rotation direction confirmed solo before coupling
Connected process piping tested, flushed and cleared
Seal flush/gas, cooling water and instrument air utilities live
typical_exceptions: Close-coupled pumps (pump and motor on one shaft) need no field coupling alignment
Vertical in-line pumps mount on the pipe and skip baseplate grouting
Small packaged pump sets arrive pre-aligned on a skid — field work is anchoring and piping only
Grease-lubricated small machines skip the oil-flush step
evidence: The pump was coupled and started before a solo rotation-direction check and before the lube system was flushed to cleanliness spec, with final alignment done before suction/discharge piping was connected.
